notes.title: Nullstar: Solus Official Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello pilots, It’s officially demo time!
[/p][p]Thank you so much for all your patience and support following the playtest, we have been hard at work hitting milestones for release and working with our publisher and development support team in getting the final big chunks of the game done.[/p][p][/p][p]What we have here is the demo that will feature in the upcoming [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] which will run from [b]October 13th to 20th[/b]. This demo is a product of the team’s incredible hard work as well as the support, you and fellow pilots, have provided.[/p][p][/p][p]This updated demo once again features World 1 of the game but with some big changes, this include:[/p][list][*][p]A reworked tutorial, better explaining the air-brake system and the importance of why managing your thrusters and air paths are key.[/p][/*][*][p]Level structure balancing, we have tweaked when some levels take place to make on-boarding easier.[/p][/*][*][p]Level balancing, we have made some levels easier, some harder and added some curve balls.[/p][/*][*][p]SFX and VFX updates.[/p][/*][*][p]2 all new master levels for you try your hand at.[/p][/*][/list][p]It’s been awesome to see these final details go in and thank you all for your support once again. [/p][p][/p][p]Please consider join our community [url="https://discord.gg/9TdSgUR4uP"]Discord[/url] to come share your thoughts and share your best times, we will also be running some competitions throughout the demo lifespan.[/p][p][/p][p]For those of you who are attending PAX Aus 2025 and SXSW Sydney 2025 we will be there and have this demo available to play on site as well as some competitions.[/p][p][/p][p]If you haven't already please consider [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3094210/Nullstar_Solus/"]wishlisting[/url] the game and we look forward to sharing launch information with you very soon!
[/p][p]Safe travels pilots![/p]

notes.title: August Update!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey pilots! We are back with another monthly update![/p][p][/p][p]Over the past month we have been putting the final touches on some of our end game levels namely worlds 4 and 5. It has been amazing to see the team work together to create some truly gorgeous looking levels but also from the level design side of things... a bit mean.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/449dfa7500d6653d5ceeb3a7bb37d4399778ce6b.png"][/img][/p][p]Some of the newer levels have been going through some vigorous play sessions though to make sure they don't cause to much grief for players. [/p][p][/p][p]The aim of the game is to be hard, but not hurl your controller and break things hard. So this month has been a lot of playtesting and tweaking of levels to make sure they are not just challenging but also fun. [/p][p]
This week we had a local meet up with Tas Game Makers in Launceston. It was great to meet so many new faces as well as see some old faces and talk about everything games and how we as a state are working to put our mark on the games industry.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/180d6ca2f0ad276e1afbcef3a670533ef861be7f.jpg"][/img]Photo provided by Tas Game Makers, learn more [url="https://tasgamemakers.com/"]here[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Our next major event is [b]PAX Aus 2025![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]We are taking a build of the game that features a bunch of fixes from the playtest, updated tutorial, control changes and some previews of other levels! We are excited to becoming back to Melbourne and showcasing what we have achieved over the last 12 months.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/d828369448c8f56fe9f733ce76dd6227e6a06a8b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]So if you are there, make sure to stop by and say hi! Check out the game and of course chat with us to help us make this the best game it can be! Speaking of showcases though...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/b610e1606764f5e461d009f691da06d499b4ceb9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Nullstar has been accepted into the 2025 ANZ indie showcase hosted by The Indie Brew. Last years event was amazing and we can't wait to showcase the game alongside other incredible ANZ games. Make sure to tune in on September 5th AEST.[/p][p][/p][p]And that's it for this month. We are as always hard at work on the game and trying to hit the necessary milestones for launch. You can keep in touch via our Discord or socials which can be found on our Steam page.[/p][p][/p][p]Til next time pilots![/p]

notes.title: July Update!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello pilots!

We are back with another update this time for July! The team has just come back from Adelaide and participating at AVCon 2025. It was a fantastic event with a deeper focus on interacting with players. Sometimes events like PAX and that cause of the volume, you don't really get to spend much time with players so events like AVCon and TGX are great ways to meet you all and chat about the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/bba04d45343dbd723dd9ead4302555a53e6f5533.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Speaking of the game, things are progressing positively as always. As we have explained in the past, the major lift of the game currently is the bespoke art for each level. We just wrapped up all the levels for world 3 (small teaser below) and are excited to begin our in house QA to make sure these levels not only look great but play great as well.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/14949a891d93df82615fd0f640b0b0b7ab99397d.png"][/img][/p][p]As we enter the back half of the year we will be slowing down on events and really only currently have PAX Aus (Oct 10th - 12th at the MCEC in Melbourne) and SXSW Sydney (Oct 13th - 19th in and around  Sydney) as our planned events. We will update if anything changes!

For now keep an eye on our socials as usual, join our ongoing playtest as well as our discord!

Til next time![/p]

notes.title: Nullstar: Solus - One Year On!
notes.notes:
[p]Holy moly pilots! Can you believe it has been [b]one whole year[/b] since we started this amazing project. From the bottom of our hearts, we here at Smash Attack can't thank you all enough for the support we have received following the games inception.

A lot of us came off a rough game launch from a previous release and needed to find new work. But through all that we came back together and created something we think is truly special![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/51004a9a80a8a4b44eee6b25bdc3e77856733028.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It's been crazy to think that the game is only [b]12 months[/b] [b]old[/b] and we have achieved so much as a team. From the way we work together to our pipelines of development, each day we feel more and more like a real studio coming together to make something we are truly proud of.

When you compare what the game used to look like to now, the hard work of the art team is definitely on show. You see how the game runs and sounds and know that right there is Dave and Alec hard at work getting the game to where it needs to be.[/p][p]
Don't get us wrong, we got a bit of work to do as we head down but with support from our publisher (indie.io) and friends in the industry we know the road ahead is looking good![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/8bc48229afbf02ce1ff336f9c03e62ce77285ab6.png"][/img][/p][p]The road we traveled has also been an exciting one! From Gamescom 2024 to the recent Frosty Games Fest, it has been a roller coaster of a ride filled with the many highs and lows of game dev. But for the most part it has been an excellent journey, especially our recent playtest which saw nearly [b]400[/b] players sign up and participate and provide feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Paired with an amazing guest appearance from guest writer Alanah Pearce, it has truly been awesome finally getting the game into as many hands as possible. And with grants from Screen Tas and Screen Aus we have been able to really put our all in.
[/p][previewyoutube="pURNh6Jrlwc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]So what's next? [b]AVCon [/b]in Adelaide, South Australia! The team will be part of the Indie Games Room at the event which runs from [b]July 5th to 6th[/b]. We will be there alongside many other amazing developers from around the country and look forward to our first convention in SA.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/1607eb0b6e2ff865f54c808bc0402960b50d2298.jpg"][/img][/p][p]So that wraps it up for this month, we will have some more game focused updates in July as always but for now we just wanted to drop a quick update and more importantly a thank you for the past 12 months of support. 

Keep sharing the game, participate in the playtest and come say hi if you are ever at event where we are!

Til next time![/p]

notes.title: Welcome Pilots to the Nullstar: Solus Playtest!
notes.notes: [p][i]Fellow pilots![/i] It’s finally time to get in there and grab those Nullstar fragments before the planet collapses. [b]Are you fast enough to get in and out?[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/8e8d3b43720e58c0ad4ca2d278a85883ec56edc6.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for taking the time to visit Nullstar: Solus, it’s been an incredible 12 month journey from concept to Gamescom to publisher and now this, our [b][u]first big playtest[/u][/b]. From small local events to large scale conventions it is finally time to get Nullstar into as many hands as possible to make the game truly shine.[/p][p][/p][p]Firstly we want to thank the team at Frosty Games Fest for helping us put this all together as well as our publisher, [url="http://indie.io"][u]indie.io[/u][/url], for their support in getting all this up and running in a timely fashion and believing in us.[/p][previewyoutube="pURNh6Jrlwc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The playtest you are about to experience features [b]18 levels from World 1[/b] ([i]15 mainline levels and 3 master levels that are designed to truly test your skills[/i]) and [b]2 ship types[/b] ([i]the default Solus, the industry standard Nullstar collection drone and the Titan, a bit slower but it can take a few more hits. Perfect for first timers[/i]).[/p][p][/p][p]Leaderboards are also active and [i]maybe[/i] some hidden things for those who go looking![/p][p][/p][p]Our main goals for this playtest are to get feedback on how we can improve the game, as we are a small team we sometimes miss bugs or haven’t thought of an idea and this our chance to talk with our growing community which you can join on discord by clicking [url="https://discord.gg/9TdSgUR4uP"]this link[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]We also have our standard socials which you can find here ([url="https://www.facebook.com/smashattackaus/"]Facebook[/url][b]/[/b][url="https://bsky.app/profile/smashattackaus.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url])[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you again for joining us in this journey and we hope to see you around pilot![/b][/p][p][/p][p]You can also check out other games from the Frosty Games Fest here: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: World 3 and Playtest Plans
notes.notes:
Hey pilots, we are back with our monthly update and in this one we are covering new changes post TGX our work on world 3 and our goals as we head towards the middle of the year.

In our last update we briefly touched on post TGX fixes and in some local  we decided to look deeper into some of our level designs and level progression. During noticed that levels that we had earlier were proving bigger road blocks then some of the levels later down the road.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/66995a827c9e2740f94dbb998aa9099bb1b7a552.gif[/img]

So we have taken some time to make the experience a bit more enjoyable by tweaking which hazards are introduced and when the difficulty ramps up. Hopefully some more internal testing and some upcoming events will let us know if this new level progression is ideal. We have also tweaked hazard placement and amount of hazards to ensure that levels flow a bit more smoothly.

With that rework, we have started looking at the art again for World 3 which has been seen in trailers and previous demos. As with each level and world, it’s all hand made by our amazing art team and we are making sure that the greyed out levels match the goals we want for the game as well as fitting each world's theme.

Taking place in a smelting factory as with everything in Nullstar, precision and speed will help you achieve those fast times and get your name on those leaderboards. As always look out for updates on socials and you can join our Discord to be kept up to date.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/f49fdb18da6a9381cdfd61b66fb0e4f741d7de77.png[/img]

Lastly, in this update we are planning a digital demo for the game as we move towards the middle of the year with a few events as previously mentioned in the last post. There are some online events coming but please look forward to being able to play Nullstar at home.

Again thank you for all the support as always share the game around, join the [url=https://discord.gg/3zdGQCCR]Discord[/url] and all that! See you next month pilots.

notes.title: March Update - TGX and Preparing for Con Season!
notes.notes:
We are back with our March update, firstly we want to thank everyone for the recent spike in growth, always amazing to see those wishlists constantly climbing as always please share it around, join our discord and follow us on Bluesky to be kept up to date with Nullstar news especially with upcoming events!

[b]TGX and Other Events[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/02de8c7e14d4ba58319f1c2624549af02a0c0752.jpg[/img]

Over the past week we participated in TGX (The Game Expo) up in Melbourne as well as some other smaller events with local game developers. We caught up with some friends at the new Massive Monster office (Cult of the Lamb devs) as well as had our resident musical maestro, Alec, showcase the game at GDC in San Francisco. It has been a great experience getting the game out there amongst other devs and showing why we think Nullstar is something special!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/b1bc412949c231ab116a0ceb1cb2995cfa2d4fd1.jpg[/img]

[b]Art Updates[/b]

For a long time players have noticed an option on the menu called decryption and asked what that is. Well whilst we aren’t ready to fully reveal how it works yet we can share some art by the very talented Cassandra Lee (who previously worked with on Broken Roads). Cass joins the team to help with our in-game lore and is working closely with Anniemay to create the world of Nullstar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/31dd490739ba6bd36e288a65ff6d1120291425d9.jpg[/img]

[b]Gameplay Tweaks[/b]

Following some recent local playtests at Optimal Gaming and more recently TGX we are looking at making some changes to level order, difficulty and some tweaks on mechanics. Nothing that will delay the game but some important changes that we hope will make for easier onboarding and allow players to chase those fast times.

[b]Planned Conventions
[/b]
We are happy to confirm that we will be attending [url=https://www.avcon.org.au/]AVCon 2025[/url] in Adelaide (July 5 – 6) and [url=https://www.pixelexpo.org.au/]Pixel Expo: IV[/url] in Perth (September 13 - 14). We will have the TGX demo with maybe some of the above gameplay tweaks but overall if you are interested in getting your hands on the game and are in those areas come say hi!

[b]Social Media Changes[/b]

This is a quick update, we have moved all information about the game away from Twitter/X and are now exclusively on Bluesky. If you have an account and want information please click here and follow: [url=https://bsky.app/profile/smashattackaus.bsky.social]here[/url]

notes.title: World 2 and Alanah Pearce joins the team!
notes.notes:
Welcome pilots to our February update!

After a steady start in January we are back into the swing of things, from meetings to convention planning it has been all systems go! So let’s go through some of the updates on Nullstar: Solus.

Alanah Pearce (former IGN, Rooster Teeth and Santa Monica Studio writer) has joined the team as a guest writer and will be working with Anniemay on some of our codex and world building. Alanah brings a wealth of knowledge with their work in the industry from their journalistic writing to crafting quests and stories. We are truly grateful that Alanah has decided to help out the team and put a spotlight not only on indies but also Australian indie games (especially Tasmanian indie games!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/e696dd3e6ecd2cc8e7acdca49d9a70fe431ba5eb.jpg[/img]

We look forward to sharing Alanah and Anniemay’s work with you soon. We also might have to plan some VO work with Alanah, maybe another game shrug

Progress on the game continues to move along swimmingly! As you may or may not be aware each level is hand crafted by our amazing artists, we have completed world 1 and now begun world 2. The mysteries of the Nullstar, the planet and the race for the power source continue which you can learn by getting fast times and unlocking codex entries (see it all comes together).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/aedf97579d53f98ec3fd1c0447aabcc95de27435.png[/img]

Our next showcase is currently planned for The Game Expo in Melbourne. Taking place on the 22nd and 23rd of March. We will have a playable demo onsite and look forward to meeting and sharing the game with you all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/4e75a00ea10b18931647855e2908cf949b99fb2e.png[/img]

Thanks again for your time and see you in the next update!

notes.title: Blasting Into 2025!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year Pilots!

We are back and the team is ready to go as we aim for our Q4 2025 launch. So what has been happening? A lot! Whilst we can't talk about to much yet we can confirm some big news is coming over the next couple of weeks.

Firstly to talk about is the Kickstarter, whilst we did not achieve our goal this has not stopped any plans for our launch, if anything the wishlists and support have been great and put a lot of eyes on the game for us. We are considering relaunching the Kickstarter but that is a decision for down the line. For now we are just happy to be back.

That's really all in this update! Stay tuned for some major announcements coming soon!

notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement!
notes.notes:
It’s been an exciting year for us here at Smash Attack Studios especially with Nullstar: Solus and today on the launch of our Kickstarter we are super excited to announce that we are officially teaming up with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio?snr=1_2108_9__2107]indie.io (formerly Freedom Games)[/url] as the publisher for Nullstar: Solus!

[b]Who is indie.io and why?[/b]

indie.io is a dedicated indie publisher whose goal is to get indie games into as many eyes and hands as possible. From helping manage and create our store pages to working alongside us to create campaigns, they'll be instrumental in helping us reach markets we just can’t by ourselves. We decided to go with indie.io because ever since we got the game in their hands, they've understood exactly what we as a studio were trying to do with it. Since signing with them we've already seen some great outreach and engagement, and we're looking forward to moving towards release in an exciting 2025 with them!

[b]What does this mean for Nullstar?[/b]

Nothing changes! Another big pull for us when looking at publishers was IP and creative ownership and the team at indie.io aligned with us perfectly for what we wanted to achieve. Nullstar will continue to be developed, we have our Kickstarter alongside us to help and you can always follow us on our socials and join our discord to be kept in the loop.

Thank you again to indie.io and everyone who supported us! Stay tuned for more updates as our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/smashattackstudios/nullstar-solus-a-sci-fi-precision-platformer]Kickstarter campaign[/url] continues

[i]Don’t forget to wishlist and follow the game on Steam whilst you're at it! [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/8bc48229afbf02ce1ff336f9c03e62ce77285ab6.png[/img]

notes.title: Amelia Jones joins Nullstar: Solus
notes.notes:
For today’s announcement we are happy to inform you that the amazingly talented, Amelia Jones, is joining us to help bring the world of Nullstar: Solus to life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/f1abcce0383ca516ff81eb41e172267ab35301bb.jpg[/img]

[i]“I had a blast playing Nullstar: Solus and meeting the team at Gamescom, I’m so thrilled to be on board. I once was part of a choral workshop where we improvised a soundscape to outerspace - a fascinating and obscure concept that has captured my imagination ever since. I’m looking forward to working with the brilliant Alec and Mariya - making sounds together that will amplify this fantastic game.”[/i]

Amelia will be working alongside our lead audio designer, Alec Shea, to help create an enticing and captivating soundtrack that will be your guide to the world of Nullstar: Solus.

Look forward to more information about Amelia’s contributions, the soundtrack and more when our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/smashattackstudios/nullstar-solus-a-sci-fi-precision-platformer]Kickstarter campaign[/url] launches November 23rd!

You can also follow Amelia's socials by [url=https://linktr.ee/ameliajonesvocals]clicking here.[/url]

notes.title: Nullstar: Solus Kickstarter Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone we are here with an exciting announcement! Nullstar: Solus is running a Kickstarter that goes live on the 23rd of November 2024! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/23c8fd0236da633c7ff44b781f6d41edad1f3ab7.png[/img]

So, why Kickstarter? Nullstar: Solus is a self-funded passion project being made by 8 people. This Kickstarter is to support our team members further and involve the community with the end product through our Kickstarter rewards as well as help us make Nullstar: Solus the best game it can be.

How can you get involved? To prepare, we have our launch page ready [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/smashattackstudios/nullstar-solus-a-sci-fi-precision-platformer](click here)[/url] which you can follow to be alerted as soon as it goes live!

From early beta keys, to a digital soundtrack and art book we will have a variety of tiers that you will be able to choose from to help out. We also have some huge announcements lined up for the course of the campaign including some great stretch goal plans (which may or may not include some highly requested features)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/51004a9a80a8a4b44eee6b25bdc3e77856733028.jpg[/img]

Also we will have social goals, some streams and a few fun things planned throughout the campaign. So, we look forward to sharing this all with you in November and thank you again for all your support!

notes.title: The PAX Aus 2024 Debrief
notes.notes:
It’s October, you know what that means! Smash Attack heads back to Melbourne for Melbourne International Games Week and PAX Aus! This time we are bringing an all new guest: Nullstar: Solus.

As always, we want to thank Screen Tas, Screen Vic and all parties involved who make GCAP, MIGW, Play Now and PAX Aus possible. Without their support, we wouldn’t be able to travel to such amazing events. So from all of us to all of you thank you! Now onto the debrief!

Only a week and a bit after Level Up Tasmania, the team hit the road once again to showcase Nullstar: Solus. This marked the second time we had shown the game publicly in Australia and was our largest showcase for the game. Arriving on the Wednesday before it all went crazy, Dean caught up with fellow developers at the PAX Aus institute that is Boatbuilders Yard and got a breakdown of all things GCAP.

Before long, it was back to the hotel to prepare for our first event: Play Now 2024. Play Now is an initiative put together by Screen Vic whose main goal is to get locally made games in front of publishers. You have to apply prior to the event and thankfully we were successful in being chosen. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/35c0f5920b56773b6458f09a77d484067c4654da.jpg[/img]
[i]Luke clearly excited for Play Now[/i]

The event was a huge blast that resulted in many friendships, amazing talks and interactions with some personal heroes. From the team at HUMANOIB and our monitor shenanigans to meeting Michael Hing and chatting games with various devs and publishers we have only interacted with online, it was truly an amazing experience that culminated in Dean losing his mind meeting long time hero Shuhei Yoshida, former President of Sony Interactive Entertainment and now head of their indie division. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/2fef9755713527b21a75e3a14ff2c0d12c48a2d7.jpg[/img]
[i]Dean trying not to cry[/i]

Having the game in the hands of many industry legends and pillars helped us know we were on the right track. Feedback was super positive across the board, ideas floated around and we were going into PAX being like: “Dang, we got a pretty fun game here”. From Play Now, Dean and Luke met up with the rest of the team to help set up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/4a379817a84d24965d1b2902bb561b87a4323578.jpg[/img]
[i]Hingers doing his best[/i]

Being Nullstar’s first major appearance, it was great to see the team eager to get it into people's hands. With a new level, new mechanic and a team ready to go, we were suddenly at the first day of PAX Aus and what a day it was! Feedback to the new level and mechanic was extraordinary. For work that was only implemented in the week after Level Up Tasmania, the team was incredibly proud of what they accomplished.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/9244e32917951604746db22f5e1fe03512f56c40.jpg[/img]
[i]Casually bump into PAX[/i]

To breakdown all of PAX would be to write an update a gazillion lines long so we are going to cliff note it below with some photos:

Networking Night - The Friday night networking night on the showfloor at PAX is always a highlight but this year was truly special as Ron Curry, CEO of IGEA, introduced us to Tim Watts, Assistant Minister for Foreign Affairs, who was on site checking everything out. Having him play and enjoy Nullstar was a great honour and we thank anybody who throws their support behind our industry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/d828369448c8f56fe9f733ce76dd6227e6a06a8b.jpg[/img]

The Card Vending Machine - An odd highlight but almost every night we visited a TCG vending machine that had the latest Japanese set but it was broken every night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/6c35ab07cc06a5e66b51892981c90b3ed02f5ec7.jpg[/img]

Hanging Out with Devs - The yearly catch up is always great from Liz and the Ailuri team to Julian and the Cult of the Lamb team and everyone inbetween it is always a pleasure to catch up, talk about life and just overall see how we are all doing in this crazy time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/3ad22f1b74ea8b2e05fdd9e8f0fc3232b96dd150.jpg[/img]

MegaDave - Screw MegaDev, MegaDave is where it’s at! As always the end of PAX party is a great event and after the team dispersed it was good to relax with many faces I didn’t get to catch up with over the PAX week. 

Team Bonding - The best part of PAX, for a lot of the Smash Attack team this was the first time meeting Lily, Morning and each other. Spending time with each other and just overall being a bunch of crazies enjoying each other's company was truly the highlight of the entire trip.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/51004a9a80a8a4b44eee6b25bdc3e77856733028.jpg[/img]
[i]Link doing his best![/i]

We have jumped back into work since we got back, changing from demo-focused to milestone-focused. We have some amazing updates coming your way about the game. But for now, feel free to keep up to date here, follow and wishlist on Steam as well as get notified when our Kickstarter goes live!

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Smash Attack at Gamescom 2024
notes.notes:
And we’re back! Jetlagged, tired, and sore but overall back! Over the past couple of weeks, Dean and Ryan have been in Germany attending Gamescom 2024 as part of the IGEA Australian booth, alongside other Australian studios, showcasing the team’s new game, Nullstar: Solus, to the international audience in attendance.

What was a crazy non-stop ride of support and encouragement has now settled and we are eager to share a brief overview of the event as well as our goals for Nullstar moving forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/846bc1028159c5e27cc9a6700d96be5e76a4d8ab.jpg[/img]
[i]Ryan eager to see the masses![/i]

Our main goal for Gamescom was to get the game's name out there. After finishing up with Broken Roads, Ryan, myself, and the team were eager to showcase the game that we all came together to make because we loved working together.

To see the passion the team has put in over the past 2 months was awesome. From many publisher chats to even more Kolsch we are happy to say we achieved what we came to do. High numbers of traffic for the game, wishlist numbers, playtesters, and more has really shown us what type of game we have and want to make and the fact they line up with what some people in the industry are looking for feels really good! However it wasn’t all business!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/a59d9e2a23aa1f157eb73eb82099baa75a81d05e.jpg[/img]
[i]Kolsch and Currywurst![/i]

Thankfully during the event the team got to do some browsing of Gamescom as well as spending time with other developers and industry professionals. From watching Alien Romulus in a small local cinema to checking out the local currywurst and talking about games over beer, it was a great trip to get an idea of what the industry is currently doing and our place in the puzzle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/d2f3f6b115ca807fcc4efa6ce4f0791295949d62.jpg[/img]
[i]The true highlight of the trip - Dean[/i]

Dean got to play Terry in SF6 and Monster Hunter: Wilds and didn’t shut up about them so I guess it was a win for him no matter what! Ryan got to experience a bit more of Gamescom and, alongside other Aussies, spent a good long time in the indie area seeing what the world is cooking and there is some really good stuff on the horizon!

So before we finalise some things in this post we want to thank Jens and IGEA for the opportunity to be a part of the stand and showcase Nullstar: Solus. A huge thank you to Screen Tasmania for assisting us in getting here and showing the world just what Tasmania has to offer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/c6c76769447354494817b12076fcccd8825f7502.jpg[/img]
[i]See you next year?[/i]

Another big thank you to the Griffiths University students who assisted us whilst we ran around like headless chooks. Shoutout to their patience with us as Gamescom can be hectic and at some points we were completely lost in meetings.

And finally shoutout to everyone who took their time to chat with us, hang with us, play games, and overall just be part of this amazing experience. From publisher chats to other developers in other countries showcasing their local talent. We are in awe of the indie side of the industry and are eagerly awaiting where your story takes you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/79f4c91125c30bc539505fd0a4327ca872394cdd.jpg[/img]
[i]There was some intense speedrunning sessions going on at the booth![/i]

So what’s next for Nullstar Solus? Well, the next event you will be able to catch the team at will be Level Up Tasmania down in Hobart at PW1 from the 27th of September to the 29th. You can learn more about it here: [url=https://www.premier.tas.gov.au/latest-news/2024/june/level-up-tasmania-video-games-showcase.]click here[/url]

After that you can catch the Nullstar team once again at PAX Australia 2024 as part of the PAX Rising indies from the 11th of October to the 13th. We will have some more coverage on the game as we get closer to the events.

We want to thank you for all the support since the game's formal announcement in July. We only started this prototype in early June and implemented art in July so to have such colossal feedback that has universally been positive is a huge boost for the team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/d685e01d01d7d6263a2c24bb10fd854db7e15ea6.jpg[/img]
[i]Dean once again is the Gamescom Smash champ![/i]

We will aim to post more updates as development progresses but for now you can wishlist and follow the game on Steam, follow us on social media, and join our Discord channel.

Until next time, pilot! 

Nullstar Dev Team

notes.title: Nullstar: Solus - Announcement and Team Reveal!
notes.notes:
Today we are happy to formally announce the next major release from Smash Attack Studios! Nullstar: Solus, a precision platformer taking inspiration from titles such as Lunar Lander, Super Meat Boy, and Disc Room.

[previewyoutube=5XNTOk1iaWM;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Execute the Nullstar Protocol! Fly through the world of Nullstar: Solus, a sci-fi platforming adventure with stunning visuals and audio. Explore a world at its end and scavenge fragments of a broken world's powerful nullstar.[/i]

Nullstar brings our team’s love of speedrunning and precision platformers to life in our take on a dystopian sci-fi world. And speaking of team, some new and old faces have joined us to help bring the world of Nullstar together.

Dean Baron (Smash Attack Owner/Lead Programmer) returns as game director and lead game programmer. Bringing what he learnt from his time on ShapeVS and Broken Roads, he is also joined by some friends from his time on Broken Roads with Drop Bear Bytes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/430b60a46e1d534354d8b50381e138e52378bfbf.jpg[/img]
[i]ShapeVS was released in early access in 2022 and fully released in 2024.[/i]

Ryan Gee joins the team as the game’s art lead, lending his creative talents and VFX knowledge as well as a love for world-building to Nullstar. Ryan has worked with Dean to create a FromSoft-esque approach to the world by channelling the ol’ “show, don’t tell” style of storytelling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/0a9338c67c1caef2f425ad3efa75c9462ee4dde9.gif[/img]
[i]Ryan did alot of the VFX work for Broken Roads[/i]

Luke Dorman also joins the team coming from Drop Bear bringing his years of level design expertise to the field. Luke has already jumped right in and started reworking old levels and giving them a second look so they can bring the right level of challenge and speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/0d6593a397ce6920d95d979769913ab405a8f9c5.jpg[/img]
[i]Luke handled helped build the world within Broken Roads[/i]

And lastly we welcome Alec Shea to the team as the audio lead. Alec brings his years of talent on projects such as Corpse Factory, Primordial Legends, and more. Being from Tassie himself, Alec and Dean have teamed up to help bring the Nullstar world to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/23f43fa0d15e15f85caeaab6cab9c3d2dbe51204.png[/img]
[i]Alec has worked on many games and brings his years of talent to the team[/i]

Returning to the team are Stella Beech and Mitchell Pomery, bringing their previous talents and work from ShapeVS and other Smash Attack titles. We believe the team we have here is one that is backed with passion and a love for creating. Nullstar started as a prototype in late April and quickly came together with a clear vision for a precision platformer with a unique twist on movement.

We plan to launch Nullstar: Solus in 2025 and are currently planning to release the game with 80 hand-crafted levels over five worlds with some other secrets along the way. Our first major event will be at Gamescom in Cologne, Germany this month, and closer to home with Level Up Tasmania and PAX Aus 2024 later in the year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/660d8151017aa70080919473bef5fefb16d37d97.jpg[/img]
[i]Smash Attack Studios returns to Germany in 2024[/i]

We will be providing some dev logs and other content on the game soon but for now you can follow us on our socials as well as wishlist the game on Steam. We look forward to sharing more with you over the coming months of development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119689/a424519500d8d841cd8c890cea670f4b0773f211.png[/img]

If you are from media or a content creator and want to learn more about the game or are just keen on Nullstar you can join our discord and have one of the team be in touch.

Thank you again, and we look forward to seeing you out there, pilot!
